name: LibreMines v2.1.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Add macOS build instructions by @ibara in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/63
* Bump to CMake 3.5, Update license year to 2025 by @yigitsalar in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/68
* Fix infinite loop in SLOT_cleanCell when too many mines are configured by @Bollos00 in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/69
* Add comprehensive GitHub Copilot instructions with C++ coding best practices for LibreMines by @Copilot in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/67
* Update GitHub Actions workflows: Add macOS with Homebrew, remove Ubuntu 20.04, add Ubuntu 24.04, support multiple macOS versions including macOS 15, and fix macOS app bundle generation by @Copilot in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/71
* Add GitHub Actions workflow to generate Linux AppImage by @Copilot in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/73
* Update Windows GitHub Actions workflow to use Qt 6.8.* LTS with MSVC 2022 by @Copilot in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/75
* Automate release asset generation on new releases using GitHub Actions by @Copilot in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/77
* Update copyright year to 2025, upgrade version to 2.1.0, upgrade cmake min version to 3.10, improve workflows by @Bollos00 in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/78

## New Contributors
* @ibara made their first contribution in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/63
* @yigitsalar made their first contribution in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/68
* @Copilot made their first contribution in https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/pull/67

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Bollos00/LibreMines/compare/v2.0.1...v2.1.0

name: LibreMines version 1.7.1 released
body:
* Use QStandardPaths to manage user configurations and scores.

Note: the location of the configuration and score files may have changed according to the system. 

In GNU/Linux systems, the path still is `~/.local/share/libremines`, while in Windows it changed to `"C:/Users/<USER>/AppData/Local/libremines"`. See [the Qt documentation for more details](https://doc.qt.io/qt-5/qstandardpaths.html).
